name: Switzerland
prevalence_note: Swiss Crime Prevention and cantonal police 2025-2026: fake police shock calls collecting valuables, TWINT or e-banking approval scams, and spoofed fedpol robocalls dominate.
cross_border_note: Under BAKOM Art. 26a Abs. 6 FDV (effective Jan 1, 2026 for Swiss fixed numbers and Jul 1, 2026 for Swiss mobile numbers), Swiss telecom operators must filter or strip caller ID on unverified international inbound calls spoofing +41 numbers; cross-border rings target German-, French-, and Italian-speaking cantons via foreign prefixes, SIM-box relays, and press-1 robocalls.

scams.name: Falsche Polizisten / Schockanruf (Wertsachen)
scams.name_en: Fake police shock call collecting valuables
scams.signals_en: Fake cantonal police say a relative caused a serious accident or burglars target the owner, demand strict secrecy and send a courier for cash or valuables.
scams.legit_en: Real Swiss police never collect cash or valuables at the door and never ask people to keep it secret from their family.
bait_tactics: Besorgt klingen und langsam nach Namen, Posten und Aktenzeichen fragen
Sagen, dass der Tresorschlüssel bei der Nachbarin ist, und fragen, wie der Kurier genau vorgeht

scams.name: TWINT / E-Banking Freigabe
scams.name_en: Fake support asking for a TWINT code or a payment approval
scams.signals_en: Poses as TWINT or bank support about a suspicious debit and asks the owner to read out a TWINT code, scan a QR code or approve a payment in the app.
scams.legit_en: Real TWINT and bank support never ask for codes, QR scans or payment approvals on the phone.
bait_tactics: Sagen, dass die App gerade nicht aufgeht, und sich langsam erklären lassen, wo der Code steht
Nachfragen, welche Abbuchung genau gemeint ist und von welchem Tag

scams.name: Falscher fedpol-Anruf
scams.name_en: Spoofed fedpol or federal prosecutor robocall
scams.signals_en: A recorded voice or fake officer from fedpol says the owner's identity was misused and they must pay or transfer money to avoid a criminal complaint.
scams.legit_en: Real federal authorities write letters and never demand payments or transfers on the phone.
bait_tactics: Verwirrt nachfragen, welches Verfahren gemeint ist, und sich alles langsam erklären lassen
Sagen, dass man erst die Brille holen muss, und um die Aktennummer bitten

scams.name: Falscher technischer Support
scams.signals_en: A caller from a software company says the computer is infected and asks to install AnyDesk or open TeamViewer, then to log in to e-banking.
scams.legit_en: Software companies never call about viruses and never ask to control a computer or watch e-banking.
bait_tactics: Sagen, dass der Computer sehr langsam startet, und fragen, was auf dem Bildschirm stehen soll
Fragen, welche Fehlermeldung sie bekommen haben

scams.name: Faux policiers et appel choc en Suisse romande (caution ou mise en sécurité)
scams.name_en: Fake Swiss cantonal police or shock call demanding bail cash or handover of valuables
scams.signals_en: Caller impersonates French-speaking Swiss cantonal police, fedpol, or a prosecutor claiming a relative caused a severe traffic accident requiring urgent cash bail or burglars targeted the victim's home...
scams.legit_en: Swiss cantonal police, fedpol, and courts never demand cash bail over the phone and never send couriers to collect cash, bank cards, PINs, or jewelry.
bait_tactics: Dites d'une voix tremblante que le guichet de votre agence locale exige un préavis pour les gros retraits et demandez comment procéder
Faites répéter lentement le nom du poste de police cantonal en feignant de chercher un stylo qui fonctionne
Expliquez que votre coffre domestique est bloqué depuis des mois et demandez s'il faut attendre le retour d'un voisin pour l'ouvrir

scams.name: Faux service sécurité bancaire ou TWINT (validation d'app et prise de contrôle)
scams.name_en: Fake Swiss bank or TWINT security support demanding app validation code or remote access
scams.signals_en: Caller spoofs a Swiss bank hotline, TWINT support, or federal authority in French, warning of unauthorized TWINT or e-banking debits and pressuring the victim to read out SMS/e-banking codes, approve a TWINT push prompt, or install remote-access software.
scams.legit_en: Swiss banks and TWINT never ask customers by phone to share SMS/App login codes, approve push requests to cancel payments, or install remote-control tools.
bait_tactics: Indiquez que l'application TWINT demande une mise à jour système très lente sur votre téléphone et décrivez une barre de chargement bloquée
Prétendez ne pas retrouver vos lunettes de lecture pour lire l'écran d'authentification et demandez d'attendre pendant que vous cherchez dans le salon
Demandez dans quel canton se situe le centre de sécurité bancaire et feignez une mauvaise réception téléphonique

scams.name: Falsi poliziotti e chiamate shock in Ticino (cauzione o consegna valori)
scams.name_en: Fake Ticino police or shock call demanding urgent bail cash or handover of valuables to a courier
scams.signals_en: Caller poses in Italian as Polizia cantonale Ticino, prosecutor, or hospital staff claiming a relative caused a severe accident requiring immediate cash/gold bail, or claiming burglars targeted the home so a plainclothes courier must collect cash, cards...
scams.legit_en: Polizia cantonale Ticino and Swiss judicial authorities never request bail money by phone and never send plainclothes officers or couriers to collect cash, cards, or jewelry.
bait_tactics: Rispondete con tono agitato che lo sportello bancario del paese chiude a mezzogiorno e chiedete se bisogna prenotare il prelievo in franchi
Chiedete di sillabare lentamente il nome della sede del posto di polizia mentre fingete di cercare carta e penna
Dite che la chiave della cassetta in cantina è rimasta in un'altra giacca e tenete l'interlocutore in attesa

scams.name: False autorità federali o sicurezza TWINT / e-banking (codici e accesso remoto)
scams.name_en: Fake Swiss federal authority, bank, or TWINT security call demanding app codes or remote access
scams.signals_en: Automated or live call in Italian spoofing Swiss federal authorities (fedpol/customs), a Ticino bank, or TWINT support, alleging identity misuse or suspicious transfers and urging the victim to press 1, install remote-access software...
scams.legit_en: Swiss federal offices (fedpol, UFCS/BACS), banks, and TWINT never use robocalls demanding press-1 actions, remote-access tools, or safe-account transfers.
bait_tactics: Spiegate che il telefono aziendale blocca il download di nuove applicazioni e chiedete passo dopo passo quale impostazione aprire
Fingete che la notifica sull'app bancaria sia scomparsa dallo schermo proprio adesso e chiedete di spiegare nuovamente la procedura
Domandate la sede dell'ufficio federale a Berna e fate ripetere ogni lettera con l'alfabeto telefonico
